excerpts.exact_text: The Company shall take all action necessary in accordance with applicable Laws and the Organizational Documents of the Company to duly give notice of, convene and hold (in person or virtually, in accordance with applicable Law) a meeting of its stockholders for the purpose of obtaining the Company Stockholder Approval
the Joint Proxy Statement shall include the Company Board Recommendation.
Once the Company has established a record date for the Company Stockholders Meeting

the Joint Proxy Statement shall include the Parent Board Recommendation.
Once Parent has established a record date for the Parent Stockholders Meeting
the Company (i) shall be required to adjourn or postpone the Company Stockholders Meeting
(ii) may adjourn or postpone the Company Stockholders Meeting
with Parent’s consent, such Company Stockholders Meeting may be adjourned or postponed every time the circumstances described in the foregoing clause (ii) exist
